rules.name: shock
rules.description: ATR14 percentile >= 95 over a 252-bar window, or a very large one-day / five-day move. This isolates violent volatility bursts before trend labels.

rules.name: compression
rules.description: ATR14 percentile <= 25 and the 20-day high-low range is in the lower 35% of its 252-bar history.

rules.name: uptrend
rules.description: Close > EMA50 > EMA200, EMA50 rising over 20 bars, and 60-day return > +3%.

rules.name: downtrend
rules.description: Close < EMA50 < EMA200, EMA50 falling over 20 bars, and 60-day return < -3%.

rules.name: transition
rules.description: Directional 20-day or 60-day movement is material, but the EMA stack has not confirmed a clean trend.

rules.name: chop
rules.description: Default state: mixed EMA structure, weak directional movement, or range movement without compression.

major_episodes.label: post-spike compression / range
major_episodes.read: Gold paused after the 2016 upside move; volatility contracted and direction was unreliable.
major_episodes.specialist: R3 compression or R4 range; avoid chasing trend continuation.

major_episodes.label: broad chop with short trend bursts
major_episodes.read: Range-dominant structure with intermittent upside legs that did not persist cleanly.
major_episodes.specialist: R4 range/reclaim first; R1 only when router confirms a clean uptrend sub-state.

major_episodes.label: compression into downtrend
major_episodes.read: Low-volatility squeeze resolved into a persistent bearish leg.
major_episodes.specialist: R3 compression-break followed by R2 downtrend short.

major_episodes.label: base-building chop
major_episodes.read: Gold stopped falling, but trend quality stayed mixed before the 2019 breakout.
major_episodes.specialist: R4 range/reversal; wait for R1 breakout confirmation.

major_episodes.label: major bull expansion with shock bursts
major_episodes.read: The first major decade bull leg; shock months appeared inside the upside trend.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 uptrend long, with R0 shock throttle during violent expansion.

major_episodes.label: post-bull correction / chop-to-downtrend
major_episodes.read: The 2020 bull leg cooled into range, then downside pressure.
major_episodes.specialist: R4 range defense first; R2 only after structural downtrend confirms.

major_episodes.label: compression and range rotation
major_episodes.read: Mostly low-volatility compression/range with false directional starts.
major_episodes.specialist: R3 compression and R4 failed-break specialists.

major_episodes.label: upside event shock
major_episodes.read: Fast geopolitical/inflation repricing; volatility dominated normal trend logic.
major_episodes.specialist: R0 event/shock handling; R1 only after volatility normalizes.

major_episodes.label: Fed/USD downtrend
major_episodes.read: Persistent bearish regime after the event spike failed.
major_episodes.specialist: R2 short specialist; long continuation should be routed off.

major_episodes.label: recovery uptrend with shock rally
major_episodes.read: Reversal from the 2022 lows into renewed upside trend.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 long after transition; R0 around shock spikes.

major_episodes.label: compression then violent reversal
major_episodes.read: Summer compression broke down, then reversed sharply in October.
major_episodes.specialist: R3/R4; avoid assuming downtrend continuation after extended compression breaks.

major_episodes.label: fresh bull breakout / high-vol uptrend
major_episodes.read: New upside leg with March-April acceleration.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 long, with shock throttle during acceleration.

major_episodes.label: bull trend with mid-year chop and year-end pause
major_episodes.read: Trend remained constructive, but entry quality depended heavily on regime routing.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 when clean; R4 during pauses.

major_episodes.label: extreme bull expansion / crowded upside
major_episodes.read: The strongest upside phase in the sample; this is where the long specialist harvest came from.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 long was the correct engine; R0 throttle needed during shock months.

major_episodes.label: bull break into chop/downtrend
major_episodes.read: The market stopped rewarding long continuation; exact-MT5 router confirms chop in Mar-May and downtrend in June.
major_episodes.specialist: R1 off; R2 downtrend plus R4 chop are the missing coverage.
